# Riemann Hypothesis / Weil Positivity — Roadmap

*Generated by pm-riemann on 2026-08-12 17:05. Manual edits will be overwritten on next sweep
— push back via OVERRIDE mail or by editing the PM config.*

**Where this stands, in one paragraph.** The programme reached its stated fallback target and
then passed it. `paper/positivity-obstruction.tex` now contains an **unconditional** upper
bound, $\limsup\mu^{-1}\log s(\mu)\le-4\pi$, a rate Connes–Consani plot as a figure and never
name. Four supporting theorems were proved today (Q1, Q2, Q3, H0), the numerics have a second
independent implementation, and the elementary layer is machine-checked in Lean. **And the
paper's thesis is unchanged by all of it:** the house-rule table gained five rows for the five
new theorems and *every one is sign-blind*. The prolate mechanism governs magnitude; the sign
is RH; the two do not connect, and that is the result.

  instructs the polecat to reject its premise early. It has paid five times.
